name: Brainstorm Session
description: All ideas captured, clustered by theme, with the favourites and next experiments.
outline: State the problem or question the session was about.
List every idea that was suggested, even small ones, as one-line bullets.
Cluster the ideas under themes with short headings.
Mark the ideas the group showed most interest in.
List the experiments or next steps agreed, with owners where given.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Ideas by Theme
### Pricing
- Free tier with limits

## Favourites
- Free tier with limits
